author: Karl Rock
description: While exploring Karachi's biggest video game and piracy market, the Rainbow Centre, I came across the Bollywood film Dhurandhar being sold. Since 2019 Indian films have been banned from playing in Pakistan cinemas. Funnily enough, the main actor in Dhurandhar, Ranveer Singh, is originally from Karachi, Sindh. His grandparents migrated to India during partition.
title: Dhurandhar Found in Pakistan!
